# McDonald's Party Planner

A group meal and party organizer for McDonald's China, built on the McDonald's China MCP. From a city, a keyword, a headcount and a budget it builds at least two truly priced, comparable group plans across stores (budget, balanced and generous variants, with totals, per person amounts and over budget flags). It also chains the themed party and tasting session flow (city, store, date, session) in dry run by default, so you see the bookable payload without ordering, and it uses the campaign calendar plus nearby stores to advise when to hold the event. Important packaging fact: the skill folder contains SKILL.md only, and its workflow runs python -m src.cli from a full clone of the repository, with a .env file at the repository root holding the token, so the repository clone is part of using it, not an optional extra.
